standard_bearer.name: Standard-Bearer
standard_bearer.desc: Banner: Legion allies in the same row get +{amount} ATK.

veteran.name: Veteran
veteran.desc: Hardened: +{atkPerHit} ATK each time it takes damage, up to +{max}.

skirmisher.name: Skirmisher
skirmisher.desc: Spotter: attacks the target with the highest ATK.

lancer.name: Lancer
lancer.desc: Lance: if its push causes a collision, collision damage +{amount}.

commander.name: Commander
commander.desc: Rally: at battle start all allied Riders get +{initiative} initiative and +{atk} ATK.

adept.name: Adept
adept.desc: Marksman: hits along the whole diagonal.

novice.name: Novice
novice.desc: Heal: after attacking (or instead of moving if no enemy is in range) heals the most wounded diagonal ally for {amount}.

stormcaller.name: Stormcaller
stormcaller.desc: Squall: the piece the target crashes into is pushed too (chain of up to {maxLinks} links).

oracle.name: Oracle
oracle.desc: Foresight: at battle start the ally with the most HP gets a {amount} shield.

warden.name: Warden
warden.desc: Steady: pushes against it are {pushResist} weaker.

sentry.name: Sentry
sentry.desc: Retaliation: an attacker in an adjacent square takes {amount} damage.

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.desc: Taunt: enemies with the Bastion in their attack zone must attack it.

2.name: Formation
2.desc: +{armorPerNeighbor} armor for each adjacent Legion ally, up to +{max}.

4.name: Promotion
4.desc: A Legion piece that reaches the enemy's back row gets +{hp} HP, +{atk} ATK and attacks all 8 adjacent squares (once per battle).

2.name: Charge
2.desc: Each Rider's first attack in a battle deals ×{multiplier} damage.

4.name: Breakthrough
4.desc: After a jump, a Rider pushes every adjacent enemy by {power}.

2.name: Blessing
2.desc: Every {every} ticks, each Mystic heals its diagonal allies (1 square) for {amount}.

4.name: Curse
4.desc: Each Mystic attack lowers the target's armor by {armor} for the rest of the battle.

4.name: Wall
4.desc: A piece pushed by a Guard into another piece or the edge is stunned for 1 tick and takes +{collisionBonus} collision damage.
